   **Bugs und Stabilität.**

         **Review-Beispiele:**

Its virtually useless!!! Updated 02.06.26 have tried to factory reset device, delete and reinstalled the App and it now refuses to connect and will only show the QR code. Utterly useless. Xiaomi you have lost a loyal customer Updated 29.08.26 This App will not let report to Feedback. This is the only way I can vent my frustrations. It will not sync correctly to my phone. The data on the device is completely different to the data presented on the app. How can you tell how you are progressing if the data on the phone is incorrect? Do Xiaomi even check this feedback on the App Store? I very much doubt it as they have never replied to me."
            2. _Amir hosein Abedian_, 28.08.2026, 1/5: "Makes my whole phone slow! Also cannot sync with my mi band 9! I tried everything! Cannot maintain connection with mi band 9 either during a workout."
